title: Adhyaya 11: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 11.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 11.

verses.original: यथा यथा मनस्तस्य दुष्कृतं कर्म गर्हति । तथा तथा शरीरं तत्तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā manastasya duṣkṛtaṁ karma garhati | tathā tathā śarīraṁ tattenāadharmeṇa mucyate ||
verses.translation: In proportion as a man's mind detests his evil deed, in that same measure his body and soul are liberated from that unrighteousness.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Genuine inner repentance and moral abhorrence of wrong deeds dissolves karmic guilt.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: In proportion as a man's mind detests his evil deed, in that same measure his body and soul are liberated from that unrighteousness.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 11: Genuine inner repentance and moral abhorrence of wrong deeds dissolves karmic guilt.

verses.original: कृत्वा पापं हि संताप्य तस्मात्पापात्प्रमुच्यते । नैवं कुर्यां पुनरिति निवृत्त्या पूयते नरः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pāpaṁ hi saṁtāpya tasmātpāpātpramucyate | naivaṁ kuryāṁ punariti nivṛttyā pūyate naraḥ ||
verses.translation: Having committed a wrong, by feeling sincere remorse one is freed from that sin; by resolving 'I will never do this again' and desisting, a person is purified.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Purification is realized through moral resolve and irreversible cessation of wrongful actions.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Having committed a wrong, by feeling sincere remorse one is freed from that sin; by resolving 'I will never do this again' and desisting, a person is purified.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 11: Purification is realized through moral resolve and irreversible cessation of wrongful actions.
